51501993.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to human GLS1 assessed as dissociation constant by surface plasmon resonance analysis

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods - Surface plasmon: The SPR binding assays were performed on a Biacore T200 instrument (GE Healthcare). GLS1 protein (1 μM, 200 μL) was covalently coupled on CM5 chip according to standard procedure. The whole system was equilibrated overnight first with assay buffer (10 mM Tris pH 8.5, 150 mM NaCl, 0.05% (v/v) surfactant P20, and 0.25% (v/v) dimethyl sulfoxide). Compounds were diluted with assay buffer and then injected at a flow of 30 μL/min for 60 s to contact, followed by disassociation for 400 s. The equilibrium dissociation constants of the compounds were determined by Biacore T200 evaluation software (GE Healthcare).
original_paragraph.Figure 3 caption: Fig. 3. Representative inhibitors 41c and 41e directly bound to GLS1. (A) Thermal stability of GLS1 treated with 41c and 41e, determined by a standard PTS assay. ΔTm values were obtained from the mean values of three independent assays. (B) Chemical structures of 41c and 41e. (C) SPR-based binding assay of 41c, 41e, and CB839 with GLS1.
original_paragraph.Figure 3C sensorgram labels: 41c Kd = 81 nM 41e Kd = 52 nM CB839 Kd = 106 nM Concentrations: 10000 nM, 5000 nM, 2500 nM, 1000 nM, 500 nM, 250 nM, 125 nM, 62.5 nM, 31.2 nM, 15.6 nM, 7.8 nM, 3.9 nM
original_paragraph.Results section - 2.5 Representative inh: SPR (Fig. 3C) analysis indicated that 41c and 41e exhibited robust binding affinity with GLS1 protein, the dissociation constants (Kd) being 81 nM and 52 nM, respectively, which was stronger than CB839 (Kd: 106 nM). Considering that 41e exhibited the best GLS1 binding affinity, 41e was selected for further evaluation.
